_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4). Based on games-steamcmd sonsoftheforest/egg-sons-of-the-forest.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence). Octail adds the sons-of-the-forest tag, automatic query and BlobSync ports written to dedicatedserver.cfg too, the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, the no_console_input flag (Wine reads no commands), install sandbox defaults and resource hints, makes the password optional (-dedicatedserver.Password only when set; upstream defaulted to changeme), saves in slot 1 by default (upstream's 0000000001 turned into a string in the json config), skips the network accessibility test by default, writes steam_appid.txt (1326470, the game's app id) in the install and before every start when it is missing (the server's self-test otherwise creates it and stops with "Please restart the server" on the first start), stops with Ctrl+C handed to the server by a trap (the wine image runs the line in bash as PID 1, which ignores it otherwise; upstream's ^^C was a kill) and ends the container with the server, downloads the config templates from the pinned commit instead of the old parkervcp/eggs path (failed downloads fail the install), and makes the install fail when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: Sons Of The Forest
author: eggs@goover.dev
description: Sons of the Forest is a horror survival game and sequel to The Forest by Endnight Games, Ltd.. Sent to find a missing billionaire on a remote island, you find yourself in a cannibal-infested hellscape. Craft, build, and struggle to survive, alone or with friends.
startup: [ -f steam_appid.txt ] || echo 1326470 > steam_appid.txt; wine ./SonsOfTheForestDS.exe -userdatapath "/home/container/serverconfig" -dedicatedserver.IpAddress "0.0.0.0" -dedicatedserver.GamePort "{{SERVER_PORT}}" -dedicatedserver.QueryPort "{{QUERY_PORT}}" -dedicatedserver.BlobSyncPort "{{BLOBSYNC_PORT}}" -dedicatedserver.MaxPlayers "{{MAX_PLAYERS}}" $( [ -z "${SRV_PW}" ] || printf -- '-dedicatedserver.Password %s' "${SRV_PW}" ) -dedicatedserver.GameMode "{{GAME_MODE}}" -dedicatedserver.SkipNetworkAccessibilityTest "{{SKIP_TESTS}}" -dedicatedserver.SaveSlot "{{SAVE_SLOT}}" -dedicatedserver.LogFilesEnabled "true" -dedicatedserver.TimestampLogFilenames "true" & SOTF_PID=$!; trap "kill -INT ${SOTF_PID} 2>/dev/null; wait ${SOTF_PID}" INT TERM; wait ${SOTF_PID}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# steamcmd Base Installation Script
#
clear
RED='\033[0;31m'
GREEN='\033[0;32m'
YELLOW='\033[1;33m'
BLUE='\033[0;34m'
NC='\033[0m'

echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
echo -e "${YELLOW}Sons of the Forest Installscript${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"

echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
echo -e "${YELLOW}download and install steamcmd. please wait...${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"

## just in case someone removed the defaults.
if [[ "${STEAM_USER}" == "" ]] || [[ "${STEAM_PASS}" == "" ]]; then
    echo -e "steam user is not set.\n"
    echo -e "Using anonymous user.\n"
    STEAM_USER=anonymous
    STEAM_PASS=""
    STEAM_AUTH=""
else
    echo -e "user set to ${STEAM_USER}"
fi

## download and install steamcmd
cd /tmp
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -sSL -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server
echo -e "${GREEN}..done..${NC}"

## install game using steamcmd
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
echo -e "${YELLOW}install game using steamcmd. please wait...${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} $( [[ "${WINDOWS_INSTALL}" == "1" ]] && printf %s '+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows' ) +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) ${INSTALL_FLAGS} validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done
echo -e "${GREEN}..done..${NC}"

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/SonsOfTheForestDS.exe" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the Sons of the Forest dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi

## Octail: the server's self-test needs steam_appid.txt (the game's app id, 1326470) next to the exe;
## without it the first start writes it and stops with "Please restart the server"
if [[ ! -f /mnt/server/steam_appid.txt ]]; then
    echo 1326470 > /mnt/server/steam_appid.txt
fi

## add below your custom commands if needed

mkdir -p /mnt/server/serverconfig
FILE=$HOME/serverconfig/dedicatedserver.cfg
if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
  echo -e "${GREEN}dedicatedserver.cfg found.${NC}"
  echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
else  
  echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
  echo -e "${RED}No dedicatedserver.cfg found. Downloading default...${NC}"
  echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
  cd $HOME/serverconfig/
  curl -fsSL -o dedicatedserver.cfg https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/sonsoftheforest/dedicatedserver.cfg || { echo "Downloading dedicatedserver.cfg failed."; exit 1; }
fi
echo -e "${GREEN}..done..${NC}"

FILE=$HOME/serverconfig/ownerswhitelist.txt
if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
  echo -e "${GREEN}ownerswhitelist.txt found.${NC}"
  echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
else  
  echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
  echo -e "${RED}No ownerswhitelist.txt found. Downloading default...${NC}"
  echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
  cd $HOME/serverconfig/
  curl -fsSL -o ownerswhitelist.txt https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pelican-eggs/games-steamcmd/8dd208975977aa24a6c53008a65a630c150806b8/sonsoftheforest/ownerswhitelist.txt || { echo "Downloading ownerswhitelist.txt failed."; exit 1; }
fi
echo -e "${GREEN}..done..${NC}"

## install end
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"
echo -e "${GREEN}Installation completed...${NC}"
echo -e "${BLUE}-------------------------------------------------${NC}"

variables.name: QueryPort
variables.description: UDP port Steam lists the server on (A2S). Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: BlobSyncPort
variables.description: UDP port the BlobSync system initialises game systems and exchanges data on. Set by Octail when the server is created (two after the game port).

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name of the server visible in the server list, and in the Steam contacts.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: The maximum number of players allowed simultaneously on the server.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players need to join; empty for none. Letters, digits and . @ # % + = : ! ~ - _

variables.name: Gamemode
variables.description: Sets the difficulty game mode when creating a new save. This parameter is ignored if loading a save (save mode set to “continue” with a save that exists on the slot). If the game mode is set to “custom”, then the custom game mode settings will be read from CustomGameModeSettings option, described later.

variables.name: Skip network Test
variables.description: true skips the network accessibility test at start (the server can fail it behind a container network even when players can join). Set it to false to run the test.

variables.name: Save Slot
variables.description: The save slot to load or create (1 is the first). To continue a save uploaded from your PC, enter its slot number (the folder name in Saves, without leading zeros).
